verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes its pricing model: usage-based billing on monthly active rows, a Free Plan with 500,000 MAR, an annual-contract discount of up to 22%, and usage-tracking docs. The predictability half of the story is undercut by concrete user reports. One says MAR billing is unpredictable with huge spikes, another says record counts were inflated about 10x by an unneeded join, and a third says you only learn real volume during the 2-week window after a new connector is set up, i.e. after connecting. Missing for 10: a published per-row rate or calculator to estimate a source's cost before connecting it, and independent evidence that bills match expectations.
